PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Cloud-synced Bathtime Bucks player profile storing virtual amusement credits, progressive prize counter, session statistics, and cabinet settings.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the parent document ID.

displayName.description: Player display name shown on the virtual amusement ticket and cabinet settings.

balanceCents.description: Current virtual amusement credit balance in cents (no real-money value).

wagerCents.description: Selected virtual play amount in cents (25, 50, 100, or 200).

progressiveCents.description: Current virtual progressive top prize meter in cents.

totalSpins.description: Cumulative spins played across synced sessions.

totalWonCents.description: Cumulative virtual credits won in cents.

biggestWinCents.description: Largest single spin or bonus virtual payout in cents.

soundEnabled.description: Whether arcade sound effects are enabled.

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether tactile vibration feedback is enabled.

skillModeEnabled.description: Whether Banilla Skill Nudge / Choose mode is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player profile was created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest synced update (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WinHistoryEntry.title: WinHistoryEntry
WinHistoryEntry.description: Immutable record of a notable Bathtime Bucks virtual win or bonus round completion synced to the player's cloud ledger.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this win history entry.

label.description: Human-readable title of the win or bonus round (e.g., DUCKY FREE SPINS, SHAMPOO PICK BONUS).

wagerCents.description: Virtual play amount in cents active during the win.

category.description: Classification of the arcade win event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the win was recorded (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user private cloud profile storing virtual amusement credits, progressive counter, stats, and cabinet preferences.

/users/{userId}/winHistory/{entryId}.description: Per-user subcollection of notable virtual wins and completed bonus round payouts.
